summary: Rapid7 Incident Command Ultimate: the full detection and response set, with SIEM, EDR, network analysis, deception and investigation in one platform.
value: Attacks are visible on computers, in the network and in logs, and can be stopped.
An infected computer is isolated, and Velociraptor investigation shows what happened.
One platform instead of separate SIEM, EDR and NDR.
simple: A complete set for detecting and responding to attacks: SIEM, endpoint protection (EDR) and network control in one platform. Collects logs from computers, sign-in systems, the cloud and SaaS; detects threats using rules (formerly Attacker Behavior Analytics) and user behavior (UEBA); on computers, lets you stop a malicious process or isolate the machine; analyzes network traffic (NDR, IDS); includes traps for attackers, AI triage of alerts, ransomware protection, investigations with Velociraptor, automated response (SOAR) and advanced threat intelligence. The Rapid7 agent on computers provides ready-made detections of suspicious processes and PowerShell commands, Office macros, password theft from memory (Mimikatz, LSASS dump) and persistence in the system; it also alerts if user credentials show up in public leaks. Logs are retained for 180 days.
classification: Adds EPP + EDR, NDR, IDS and DFIR (Velociraptor) to Advanced; Ransomware Prevention is included in Ultimate.
